failedAssertions.reason: Shell prompt does not appear - app shows 'could not start session' error (error code -1). Guest runtime encounters NULL current->mem crash during early boot sequence, preventing reaching login_ready milestone.
failedAssertions.evidence: UI snapshot shows 'could not start session' and 'error code -1' text elements instead of functional shell prompt

failedAssertions.reason: Terminal is not interactive because the error state from failed guest runtime initialization prevents any terminal input or interaction.
failedAssertions.evidence: UI snapshot shows only error message and 'k' button - no interactive terminal input field or cursor

frictions.description: Log capture via XcodeBuildMCP showed app relaunch issues due to bundle ID mismatch (app.ish.iSH vs com.rudironsoni.ish). Used direct simctl log commands as workaround.
UI snapshot revealed error state instead of functional terminal - this is expected per user-testing.md documentation: NULL current->mem crash during early boot is a known architectural issue.

blockers.description: Guest runtime execution fails due to NULL current->mem crash during early boot sequence. This prevents reaching login_ready milestone and displaying functional shell. The ISH_TASK_ZERO_FULL_RUNTIME flag is correctly set and task_start() is being called, but guest execution encounters runtime error before shell can initialize.
blockers.rootCause: do_execve() modifies current->mm and current->mem but changes may not be visible to emulator threads before task_start(). Memory barrier was added but issue persists.

summary: User testing validation for task5-full-runtime completed with 2 passed and 2 failed assertions. App builds and launches successfully (FULL-RUNTIME-001: PASS). App remains stable for 30 seconds (FULL-RUNTIME-004: PASS). However, guest runtime fails to initialize - shell prompt does not appear (FULL-RUNTIME-002: FAIL) and terminal is not interactive (FULL-RUNTIME-003: FAIL). This is a known architectural issue where the NULL current->mem crash during early boot prevents reaching the login_ready milestone. The ISH_TASK_ZERO_FULL_RUNTIME flag is correctly implemented and task_start() is being called, but the guest execution encounters a runtime error.
